10: ANNA. I suppose, then, that Yury Miroslavsky is yours too.
8: KHLESTAKOV. Why, yes. And I revise and whip all their articles into shape. Smirdin gives me forty thousand for it.
5: ANNA. What! So you are Brambeus?
3: ANNA. So you write too? How thrilling it must be to be an author! You write for the papers also, I suppose?
1: KHLESTAKOV. I know pretty actresses. I've written a number of vaudevilles, you know. I frequently meet literary men. I am on an intimate footing with Pushkin. I often say to him: "Well, Pushkin, old boy, how goes it?" "So, so, partner," he'd reply, "as usual." He's a great original.
